audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Genericity for all groups satisfying stated hypotheses, without excluding virtually cyclic groups.
limitations: Counterevidence: Theorems7.6,7.9,7.13,7.15 explicitly exclude virtually cyclic groups. Fact2.2(1) and Lemma5.1 use non-elementarity and exponential growth. Literal numerator error in7.4 is not the basis; corrected event still fails.
Counterevidence: Two-stage proof gives substantial positive evidence; no counterexample established.
Not performed: No journal Version of Record comparison; findings bind only to arXiv2408.00603v3.
Not performed: No complete independent proof of arbitrary k insertion induction (U1).
Not performed: No full reconstruction of external weak-contraction, HHG maximal-space/Morse-detection, quasi-action, CAT(0) contraction, or Garside theorems.
Not performed: No visual inspection of source pages4-6; references pages37-38 not reviewed.
Not performed: No author code execution or author-source compilation; absence of released code is not a defect.
Limits: All-k insertion proof remains incomplete in this verification.
Limits: No equivalence with the journal Version of Record asserted.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
